description: Create a bounded interview plan and evidence log from a learning goal, participant count, and available time. Returns an evidence-bounded result and the canonical web tool URL.

goal.description: The one product decision the interviews should inform, written as a sentence such as Decide which onboarding step to simplify.

minutes.description: Length of each interview in minutes, as a whole number, for example 30.

participants.description: How many people you can interview, as a whole number.

stage.description: Where the people you interview are with your product: evaluating it, new users, active users, or people who stopped using it. This picks the opening question.

name: toolfound_feedback_interview_planner
title: Customer feedback interview planner
